name: human-chrome-proxied-checkout
description: Real lab run, 2026-11-13: a person in Chrome on a Mac buying through checkout to the Stripe test payment, through the operator's own TLS-terminating reverse proxy (so the TLS/HTTP2 fingerprint is the proxy's, not Chrome's). Must stay 'not an AI agent'. Pins the Stripe.js globals fix: injected_globals must not fire on the payment page. Known gap (Phase B): type is 'script' because of the proxy's TLS mismatch although the page script proves a real browser — expectation leaves type open until that is handled.
